restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes, encoded from two independent uniform 256-bit words.
One batch of 2^129 samples; all repeated messages are retained and charged; no restart.
Uses the complete fixed-zero-state SHA3-256 sponge with 0x06 padding and prefix rounds 0 through 4.

Collision detection sorts the charged three-word records by the 256-bit digest with a two-pass least-significant-digit radix (counting) sort, 2^128 buckets per pass, fully charged in both the time and memory ledgers; memory is a reported metric only and contributes nothing to the scalar.
Classical 256-bit word RAM with independent uniform random words; fully charged generation wrapper, radix sort, scan and two retained record arrays.
Analytical generic construction; no full-scale execution, precomputed collision, or empirical heuristic is claimed.
The nominal reference identifier does not assert an improvement; the conservative scalar bound is 133 under collision-frontier-v5.
